title: The 13th sign? Here’s the truth.
caption: The Sun's path does cross Ophiuchus, but the zodiac splits it into twelve signs. Ophiuchus is not a sign, and it just wanted to belong. You do not need a title to be worth loving. Who saved you a seat?
